analysis.title: EquipmentShare (EQPT): 3Q26 First Take: 3Q beat, FY26 guide raised on Oct 19th
key_insights: EQPT reported 3Q26 core EBITDA of $535 mn vs GS estimate $447 mn and Visible Alpha consensus $471 mn, a beat of +20% vs GS and +14% vs consensus.
Equipment Rental segment sales grew +49.3% vs GS +30.7% and consensus +32%, driven by customer demand and strong fleet absorption. Segment EBITDA margin was 44.1% vs GS 43.8% and consensus 43.4%.
Average OEC (original equipment cost) grew +33.1% vs GS +30.3%. GS says this implies a utilization, mix and pricing tailwind of about +1600 bps.
Quarter-end OEC was $10.663 bn (+32.4% yoy) vs GS estimate $10.231 bn (+27%). On-balance-sheet OEC was $4.816 bn and off-balance-sheet OEC was $5.847 bn.
Equipment Sales segment sales grew +76.4% vs GS -5% and consensus +41.2%. Core sales growth was +54.2% vs GS +24.2% and consensus +33.7%.
Core EBITDA margin was 38.0% vs GS 39.5% and consensus 38.6%, so the EBITDA beat came from higher sales rather than margin.
EQPT kept its FY26 adj. EBITDA guide unchanged at $2.136-$2.224 bn (raised on Oct 19) vs GS $2.023 bn and consensus $2.059 bn. The implied core EBITDA guide is $1.902-$1.990 bn.
EQPT kept its FY26 total revenue guide unchanged at $5.808-$6.045 bn (raised on Oct 19) vs GS $5.435 bn and consensus $5.631 bn.
The implied 4Q26 core EBITDA guide is $547-$635 mn, assuming $234 mn of FY26 new market start-up costs. The midpoint is +12% vs GS $530 mn and +8% vs consensus $548 mn.
GS expects the stock reaction to depend on commentary on fleet absorption, margin sustainability and the 4Q26 outlook on the earnings call the next day.
GS rates EQPT Buy with a 12-month price target of $30, based on 6.5x its Q5-Q8 EBITDA. The stock closed at $16.21, implying 85.1% upside.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 core EBITDA beat GS and consensus on higher rental and equipment sales. FY26 guidance was unchanged from the Oct 19 raise and sits above GS and consensus. The price target was cut from $35 to $30 on 30-Sep-26, before this report.

earnings_insights: EQPT 3Q26 reported core EBITDA $535 mn vs GS est $447 mn and VA consensus est $471 mn (reported 11/9/2026).
3Q26 reported core EBITDA margin 38.0% vs GS est 39.5% and consensus est 38.6%.
3Q26 reported total revenue $1,468 mn vs GS est $1,212 mn and VA consensus est $1,288 mn (+55.5% yoy).
3Q26 reported core revenue $1,407 mn (+54.2% yoy) vs GS est $1,133 mn and consensus est $1,219 mn.
3Q26 reported Equipment Rental & Services revenue $1,113 mn (+49.3% yoy) vs GS est $974 mn and consensus est $984 mn. Segment EBITDA was $491 mn at a 44.1% margin.
3Q26 reported Equipment Sales revenue $294 mn (+76.4% yoy) vs GS est $158 mn and consensus est $235 mn. Segment EBITDA was $44 mn at a 15.0% margin.
3Q26 reported adjusted core EBITDA (excluding new market start-up costs) $594 mn vs GS est $505 mn and consensus est $528 mn. The margin was 42.2%.
3Q26 reported total company EBITDA $276 mn vs GS est $205 mn and consensus est $237 mn.

FY26 company guidance, unchanged and raised on Oct 19: adj. EBITDA $2.136-$2.224 bn and total revenue $5.808-$6.045 bn. GS FY26 estimates are adj. EBITDA $2.023 bn and revenue $5.435 bn. Consensus is $2.059 bn and $5.631 bn.
Implied 4Q26 core EBITDA guide of $547-$635 mn vs GS est $530 mn and consensus est $548 mn at the midpoint.
